dashboard.label: SASP - RoCE Network Health
dashboard.description: N9K RoCE fabric port metrics: throughput, errors, drops, and PFC watchdog for NCCL/RDMA training

search.query: index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics port="Eth1/44" | stats latest(in_bps) AS in_bps latest(out_bps) AS out_bps | eval throughput_gbps=round((in_bps + out_bps) / 1000000000, 2) | fields throughput_gbps

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics port="Eth1/38" | stats latest(in_bps) AS in_bps latest(out_bps) AS out_bps | eval throughput_gbps=round((in_bps + out_bps) / 1000000000, 2) | fields throughput_gbps

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | stats latest(pfc_mode) AS mode latest(pfc_rx_pause) AS rx_pause latest(pfc_tx_pause) AS tx_pause latest(pfc_watchdog) AS watchdog by port port_label | rename port AS "Port", port_label AS "Server", mode AS "PFC", rx_pause AS "Rx Pause", tx_pause AS "Tx Pause", watchdog AS "Watchdog"
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | timechart avg(in_bps) AS "Inbound" avg(out_bps) AS "Outbound" by port_label

panel.title: PFC Pause Frames Over Time (Rx + Tx)

search.query: index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(pfc_rx_pause) AS prev_rx last(pfc_tx_pause) AS prev_tx last(_time) AS prev_time by port | eval interval=_time-prev_time | where interval>0 AND isnotnull(prev_rx) | eval new_rx_pause=pfc_rx_pause-prev_rx, new_tx_pause=pfc_tx_pause-prev_tx | timechart sum(new_rx_pause) AS "Rx Pause" sum(new_tx_pause) AS "Tx Pause" by port_label

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(in_ucast_pkts) AS prev_in last(out_ucast_pkts) AS prev_out last(_time) AS prev_time by port | eval interval=_time-prev_time | where interval>0 AND isnotnull(prev_in) | eval in_pps=round((in_ucast_pkts-prev_in)/interval, 0), out_pps=round((out_ucast_pkts-prev_out)/interval, 0) | timechart avg(in_pps) AS "Rx pps" avg(out_pps) AS "Tx pps" by port_label

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | eval link_speed=25000000000 | eval util_in=round(in_bps/link_speed*100, 3), util_out=round(out_bps/link_speed*100, 3) | timechart avg(util_in) AS "Rx Util %" avg(util_out) AS "Tx Util %" by port_label

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(in_errors) AS prev_err last(out_discards) AS prev_disc by port | where isnotnull(prev_err) | eval new_errors=in_errors-prev_err, new_discards=out_discards-prev_disc | timechart sum(new_errors) AS "New Rx Errors" sum(new_discards) AS "New Tx Discards" by port_label

index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics | stats latest(in_bps) AS in_bps latest(out_bps) AS out_bps latest(in_errors) AS rx_errors latest(out_discards) AS tx_discards latest(in_octets) AS total_rx latest(out_octets) AS total_tx by port port_label | eval link_speed=25000000000 | eval util_pct=round((in_bps+out_bps)/link_speed*100, 2) | eval total_rx_gb=round(total_rx/1073741824, 1), total_tx_gb=round(total_tx/1073741824, 1) | rename port AS "Port", port_label AS "Server", util_pct AS "Link Util %", total_rx_gb AS "Lifetime Rx (GB)", total_tx_gb AS "Lifetime Tx (GB)", rx_errors AS "Rx Errors", tx_discards AS "Tx Discards" | fields "Port", "Server", "Link Util %", "Lifetime Rx (GB)", "Lifetime Tx (GB)", "Rx Errors", "Tx Discards"
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics port="Eth1/44" | stats latest(in_bps) AS in_bps latest(out_bps) AS out_bps | eval util=round((in_bps+out_bps)/25000000000*100, 1) | fields util
index=sasp_metrics sourcetype=sasp:switch_metrics port="Eth1/38" | stats latest(in_bps) AS in_bps latest(out_bps) AS out_bps | eval util=round((in_bps+out_bps)/25000000000*100, 1) | fields util
